description: This file contains utility functions for DOM manipulation and style computation, including shadow DOM handling, style caching, visibility checks, and element bounding box calculations.

methods.name: setGlobalOptions
methods.description: Sets global options for DOM utility functions, including browser-specific workarounds.

methods.name: isInsideScope
methods.description: Checks if an element is inside a given scope node.

methods.name: enclosingElement
methods.description: Returns the enclosing element of a node, if any.

methods.name: parentElementOrShadowHost
methods.description: Returns the parent element or shadow host of an element.

methods.name: enclosingShadowRootOrDocument
methods.description: Finds the nearest shadow root or document containing the element.

methods.name: closestCrossShadow
methods.description: Finds the closest element matching a CSS selector across shadow boundaries.

methods.name: getElementComputedStyle
methods.description: Retrieves computed style for an element, with caching based on pseudo-elements.

methods.name: isElementStyleVisibilityVisible
methods.description: Determines if an element's style makes it visible.

methods.name: computeBox
methods.description: Calculates the visibility, inline status, and bounding rect of an element.

methods.name: isElementVisible
methods.description: Checks if an element is visible based on computed styles and bounding box.

methods.name: isVisibleTextNode
methods.description: Checks if a text node is visible by its bounding rectangle.

methods.name: elementSafeTagName
methods.description: Returns the uppercase tag name of an element, handling special cases.

methods.name: beginDOMCaches
methods.description: Initializes caches for DOM style computations.

methods.name: endDOMCaches
methods.description: Clears caches for DOM style computations.
